description: Revert to the robust 8-layer/128-dim baseline with softcap=13 and Matrix LR=0.06, but reduce the Embedding Learning Rate from 0.6 to 0.45 to further stabilize token embedding updates under the 0% warmup schedule, potentially allowing the model to settle into a deeper minimum by reducing oscillation in the embedding space which has been a consistent bottleneck in previous high-LR attempts.
